## Project Overview
This is a Next.js landing page for Restometry, a restaurant labor management software. The project focuses on Phase 1 features including:

- Smart Scheduling (Basic Version)
- Attendance Tracking (Basic)
- Labor Cost Calculator
- Simple Dashboard Home
- Daily Sales Entry & Update

## Development Guidelines
- Use TypeScript for type safety
- Use Tailwind CSS for styling with a professional, modern design
- Create a single-page static landing page with no transitions
- Focus on clear, concise presentation of the Phase 1 features
- Target audience: Restaurant owners and managers
- Emphasize labor cost optimization and ease of use

## Design Principles
- Professional and clean interface
- Clear value propositions for each feature
- Mobile-responsive design
- Fast loading times
- Clear call-to-action elements
